test_title: PYST 12: SSC CHSL 2023 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: maths
question: A man invested Rs. 25,400 on simple interest for 9 years to obtain a total amount of Rs. 67,790 on a certain annual rate of interest. What was the rate of interest (rounded off to 2 decimal places) to obtain the above amount?
solution: Given: A man invested Rs. 25,400, time = 9 years , obtain a total amount= Rs. 67,790 Formula used: Simple interest = P × R × T / 100 [ P = principal, R = rate of interest, T = time]
